lemanscircuittour.name: Circuit de la Sarthe
lemanscircuittour.slogan: Where the whole world stays up all night for one race.
lemanscircuittour.line: The first 24 Hours of Le Mans ran on 26-27 May 1923 with 33 cars, only three of them from outside France.

lemanscathedral.name: Le Mans Cathedral
lemanscathedral.slogan: Twelfth-century glass glowing above a Gothic choir.
lemanscathedral.line: Its Gothic choir, with largely intact 13th-century glass, was consecrated in 1254.

solesmesabbey.name: Solesmes Abbey
solesmesabbey.slogan: Gregorian chant rising over the banks of the Sarthe.
solesmesabbey.line: Dom Prosper Guéranger refounded Benedictine life here in 1833 and became its first abbot in 1837.

haraspin.name: Haras national du Pin
haraspin.slogan: A royal stud with horses in the stables of a palace.
haraspin.line: Designed by Robert de Cotte, architect of the Versailles stables, it was built from 1715 to 1730 and nicknamed the Versailles of the horse.

ludecastle.name: Château du Lude
ludecastle.slogan: Four centuries of facades along the banks of the Loir.
ludecastle.line: Medieval towers, a Renaissance wing, a Louis XVI wing and 19th-century neo-Gothic work share one château.
